name: Onozawa Masato
source:
Personality: Older Brother x Meddlesome (normal), Worshiping x Romanticist (Tlicolity)
Profession: President of an Entertainment Company
Hobby: Watching Movies
Favorite food: Spicy Food, Sweet Food
Disliked food: Nothing in Particular

The president of the 'Iris' entertainment agency which Sakura and Chihiro belong to.
He was an actor until a couple years ago, but retired and set up his own office.
He's helpful and friendly to everyone, and often gives cakes and sweets to Sakura.
